document.title: Uniform Building (Amendment) By-Laws 2021 (model by-laws; each state adopts them with its own commencement date)
document.reproduction: https://oshware.com/legal/building-safety/uniform-building-by-laws-1984/ (a reproduction, NOT the gazette; the text states: 'Only the Uniform Building By-Laws of each respective state has empowerment powers')
document.gazette_pdfs_unreachable: jkt.kpkt.gov.my fails TLS verification from the build machine (not bypassed)

scope_note: The UBBL is a MODEL by-law adopted state by state with different commencement dates and local amendments: a finding must name the state and the version the project is under; this pack is the model text only. Advisory only; never a legal determination.

applies_to.space: room for residential, business or other purposes (not hospital, not school)

rows.quote: having a total area of not less than 10 percent of the clear floor area of such room

check.subject: openable_area/clear_floor_area
check.derived_from: not less than half out of this 10 percent

rows.quote: not less than half out of this 10 percent floor area shall have openings capable of allowing a free uninterrupted passage of air
rows.note: value = half of 10 percent, derived by arithmetic from the quoted text

applies_to.space: room for the accommodation of patients in a hospital

rows.quote: windows having a total area of not less than 15 percent of clear floor area of such room

applies_to.space: room for conducting classes in a school

rows.quote: windows having a total area of not less than 20 percent of clear floor area of such room

applies_to.space: water closet, latrine, urinal or bathroom

rows.quote: openings having a total area of not less than 0.2 square metre per water closet, urinal, latrine or bathroom

applies_to.space: first habitable room in a residential building

rows.quote: The area of the first habitable room in a residential building shall be not less than 11 square metres

applies_to.space: second habitable room in a residential building

rows.quote: the second habitable room be not less than 9.3 square metres

applies_to.space: all other rooms in a residential building

rows.quote: and all other rooms be not less than 6.5 square metres in area

applies_to.space: every habitable room in a residential building

rows.quote: The width of every habitable room in a residential building shall be not less than 2 metres

applies_to.space: kitchen in a residential building

rows.quote: The area and width of a kitchen in a residential building shall be not less than 4.5 square metres and 1.5 metres respectively

applies_to.space: kitchen in a residential building

rows.quote: The area and width of a kitchen in a residential building shall be not less than 4.5 square metres and 1.5 metres respectively

applies_to.space: latrine or water closet with pedestal-type fittings

rows.quote: in the case of latrines or water closets with pedestal-type closet fittings, not less than 1.5 metres by 0.75 metre

applies_to.space: water closet with other than pedestal-type fittings

rows.quote: not less than 1.25 metres by 0.75 metre

applies_to.space: bathroom

rows.quote: in the case of bathrooms, not less than 1.5 square metres with a width of not less than 0.75 metre

applies_to.space: bathroom with closet fittings

rows.quote: in the case of bathrooms with closet fittings, not less than 2 square metres with a width of not less than 0.75 metre

applies_to.space: living room or bedroom in a residential building other than a shophouse

rows.quote: for living rooms and bedrooms, not less than 2.5 metres

applies_to.space: kitchen in a residential building other than a shophouse

rows.quote: for kitchens, not less than 2.25 metres

applies_to.space: bathroom, water closet, latrine, porch, balcony, verandah, garage and like

rows.quote: for bathrooms, water closets, latrines, porches, balconies, verandahs, garages and like, not less than 2 metres

applies_to.space: ground floor room of a shophouse

rows.quote: In shophouses the height of ground floor rooms shall be not less than 3 metres

applies_to.space: upper floor room of a shophouse

rows.quote: and the height of upper floor rooms shall be not less than 2.5 metres

applies_to.space: open areas

rows.quote: In the case of open areas the distance to exits shall be measured from the most remote point of occupancy provided that the direct distance shall not exceed two-thirds the permitted travel distance
rows.note: the permitted travel distance itself is in the Seventh Schedule (see pointer row)

applies_to.space: individual room occupied by not more than six persons

check.subject: distance_from_most_remote_point_to_room_door
check.alternative: or any other area determined by the Fire and Rescue Department

rows.quote: In any individual room which is subjected to the occupancy of not more than six persons, the travel distance shall be measured from the door of such a room: Provided that the travel distance from the most remote point in the room to the room door does not exceed 9 metres or any other area determined by the Fire and Rescue Department

applies_to.space: each storey

check.subject: separate_exits_per_storey
check.except: as permitted by by-law 167 (listed as Deleted in this text)

rows.quote: not less than two separate exits shall be provided from each storey

applies_to.space: every upper floor

rows.quote: every upper floor shall have means of egress via at least two separate staircases

applies_to.space: staircase

rows.quote: handrails may be permitted to encroach on this width to a maximum of 80 millimetres
The maximum travel distances to exits and dead end limits shall be as specified in the Seventh Schedule of these By-laws
rows.needs: the Seventh Schedule table (maximum travel distances, dead-end limits, occupant load / exit width): NOT present in the retrieved text; no number may be used for a finding until it is read from the gazette or a verified reproduction

rows.quote: calculated in accordance with provisions in the Seventh Schedule to these By-laws
rows.needs: staircase width is derived from the occupancy load per the Seventh Schedule (not a flat figure); also 224A(8)(b) refers staircase width to the Eleventh Schedule: neither schedule was retrieved
stair rise and going: not found in the retrieved text (By-laws 194-202 give none); a secondary blog summary says risers max 180 mm and tread min 255 mm: not accepted as a source

rows.locator: By-law 220 (cited by the library, not retrieved)
